decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds directly on the firm's psychiatric treatment expertise and own R&D, so management can interpret results and refine it, and it is prominently presented on its own page.
The carpentry workshop extends the firm's established sheltered-workshop production know-how, giving it the related knowledge to learn from early results, and it has a dedicated page.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's mental health and outpatient support competences, so it can be assimilated, though its modest website presence suggests slightly lower commitment.
Senior living counseling draws on the firm's core eldercare expertise and is featured on the home page, signaling strong commitment and good absorptive fit.

The retail shop builds on the sheltered workshop's products and is supported by the firm's expanding, R&D-active base, though its minimal website presence and retail focus slightly raise the drop risk.
